investigations.name: HbA1c
investigations.plain_note: HbA1c is a blood test that reflects average blood sugar levels over roughly the past few months.

investigations.name: Fasting Plasma Glucose
investigations.plain_note: Fasting Plasma Glucose is a blood test that measures the level of sugar in the blood after a period without eating.

investigations.name: Total Cholesterol
investigations.plain_note: Total Cholesterol is a blood test that measures the overall amount of cholesterol, a type of fat, in the blood.

investigations.name: Serum Creatinine
investigations.plain_note: Serum Creatinine is a blood test that measures a waste product, often used as a general indicator of how the kidneys are working.
